title: Add magnifier while picking a color
line: While picking a color, the cursor becomes a magnifier that shows the nearby pixels enlarged, with the one being picked outlined.
explanation: Color picking (the Color Picker widget, Spectacle and anything else using org.kde.kwin.ColorPicker) goes through KWin's color picker effect, which only showed an on-screen message and the normal cursor. The cursor covers the pixel under it, so on fine detail like text or thin lines there was no way to tell which exact pixel would be picked. Now, while picking, the effect hides the cursor and draws a loupe centered on the pointer: the 13x13 pixels around it enlarged 10 times with nearest-neighbour scaling, and the pixel that will be picked outlined in black and white. It follows the mouse and the Ctrl+arrow keys (1 px steps), and disappears when the pick is done or cancelled.

commits.message:
plugins/colorpicker: show a magnifier while picking a color
